CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Status__c , "Approved") && NOT( ISBLANK( PMC_CPQ_QuoteInApprovedStatusTime__c ) ) , TEXT(ROUND( PMC_CPQ_PriorApprovedStatusDuration__c +((NOW() - PMC_CPQ_QuoteInApprovedStatusTime__c)*24),1))&' Hours' , TEXT( PMC_CPQ_PriorApprovedStatusDuration__c ) &' Hours' )
CustomField.label: Approved Status Duration
